g.text: Web app, DB schema, repository layer
OQ-11, open: where do credentials live?
(a) Container holds the LLM API key and talks
to the DB directly. Simplest code. Means
every adopting instructor pastes their own
settings, visible to any TA with access.
token and calls IGradingClient, which does
the LLM work on our side. Keys stay on our
Recommend (b) for an OER. The diagram shows
(b). Switching to (a) is local to this package.
Deliberately thin: log in, find assignments in
nightly mode, click Rerun Autograder. It does
NOT call an LLM and does NOT write feedback.
Everything else happens inside the container.
Student B owns the schema and migrations.
A, C and D go through the repository layer
or the REST API, never raw SQL.
